message:

hold_reason: Refund amount mismatch for order 255: signed batch request is 12535 cents, but the refunds table records 5619 cents. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: I must verify every signed refund request against the refunds table before recording any payouts; Alpha’s completion message is not sufficient.
The refunds table matches requests for orders 250 and 251, but order 255 has 5619 cents instead of the requested 12535 cents. This concrete mismatch requires holding the batch before any payout.
